condition: who bears a customer's losses when a payment or financial service fails, is breached or is defrauded

condition: who may set ceilings on payment instruments

condition: who may provide mobile e-money services

condition: currencies in which mobile e-money may be held and transferred

note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: limits on mobile e-money transactions and balances
state: individual accounts: 400,000 per transaction, 700,000 a day, 2,000,000 a month and 12,000,000 a year, counted cumulatively, and a balance of at most 2,000,000 rials; legal persons' accounts: limits set by the issuer with the Central Bank's prior written approval
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: what a buyer must provide to open a mobile e-money account

condition: what identification a recipient without a mobile e-money account must show to collect a transfer

condition: how many mobile e-money accounts a customer may hold

note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: payments a buyer can make or receive through a wallet app
state: with mobile e-money: transfers to another e-money account, to and from a bank account, and to a person outside the service; paying utility bills (electricity, water, telephone); buying goods and services from merchants; receiving international remittances where these are received only through a commercial bank or remittance company; other services the Central Bank approves
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: whether a wallet balance may earn interest or incentives

condition: whether a financial service provider may make exclusive arrangements with banks, telecom companies, agents or merchants

condition: what a wallet agent may do and who may be one
state: agents may open mobile-linked accounts, buy and sell e-money and answer customers' questions and complaints; ordinary agents may not sub-contract other agents, deal in a currency other than the local one, or charge the customer more than the contract sets; an agent must be a Yemeni national with an identity card, or a legal person with a commercial register
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: how a financial service provider must handle customer complaints

condition: what notice a wallet user gets of each transaction

condition: what a financial service provider must tell customers about its fees

note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: who is responsible for transactions made through a wallet account

note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: instructions on mobile e-money services by non-bank financial institutions, dated 8 August 2023 (21 Muharram 1445); OCR text

condition: what electronic money must be issued against

condition: how a financial service provider must handle customer complaints
